Nina Park: Kickoff for Aug webinar: working title 'Scaling Inference: routing, SLAs & demo fallbacks'. Want practical takeaways for infra+platform teams.
Owen Reed: Suggested format: 10m framing, 15m routing+SLA patterns, 20m live demo (with fallback), 10m audience ops Q&A. Total 55m.
Lina Morales: I'll draft two registration blurbs (tech-first and business-first) to A/B. Also will propose three CTAs: request cost estimate, try Dedicated trial, schedule a tech consult.
Theo Grant: Demo plan: show routing rules (latency vs cost), then induce a failure and execute fallback swap. DevRel-bot can prep a sandbox with seeded failure responses.
DevRel-bot: Sandbox provisioning queued. Will include toggle for recorded fallback and a pre-seeded response bundle. ETA 36h.
Nina Park: Run-of-show draft:
```
0:00 Intro & goals (Nina) - 5m
0:05 SLA patterns (Owen) - 15m
0:20 Demo: routing + failover (Theo) - 20m
0:40 Live Q&A + poll - 10m
0:50 Closing CTAs & next steps - 5m
```
Lina Morales: Rehearsal windows: Aug 5 full run, Aug 8 tech-check. @calendar-bot please create both and include fallback clip upload link.
calendar-bot: Events created: "Aug 5 Full Rehearsal" and "Aug 8 Tech Check". Recording enabled.
Owen Reed: Need inbound form fields: company, role, monthly tokens, deployment interest. Routing rule: >5M -> AE priority. Theo, can you prep a short runbook for the demo swap?
Theo Grant: On it. Will add step-by-step commands and the pre-seeded response file. Also will record a 60s fallback clip.
Nina Park: Great. Next steps: Lina finishes A/B blurbs, DevRel finishes sandbox, Theo drop runbook + clip, Owen compiles SLA examples. Locking run-of-show after rehearsal invites go out. :rocket:
